stations.title: Idris
stations.say: What is even on this laptop?

stations.title: Studio folder
stations.text: Years of files, and nobody knows where.
stations.note: Sizes and hidden files do not show.

stations.title: Notes for Idris
stations.text: Three answers, each on its own line.

captions: Ashgrove Print Studio. Idris wants to know what is on the shared laptop.
Since Sol left, the folder is a mystery, and some files do not even show.
You type your first commands to look around, in three small tasks.
Now Idris knows where the folder is, which drawing is huge, and where the note hides.
No file moved. You looked, and the laptop has a map.
